source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of core principles (PDF 162-163).

items: Decentralization: markazi idare ki bajaye computers (nodes) ka network blockchain chalata hai, jis se aik nuqte par nakami ka khatra kam hota hai.
Immutability: block judne ke baad badla ya mitaya nahi ja sakta, to transactions ki tareekh mustaqil aur chhed-chhaar se mehfooz hai.

Consensus mechanisms: Proof of Work (PoW) aur Proof of Stake (PoS) jaise qawaid jin se nodes block jorne se pehle transactions ke durust hone par mutafiq hote hain; is ke liye network ke kafi hisse (aksariyat, majority) ka mutafiq hona kaafi hai, har node ka nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke consensus mechanisms yaqeeni banate hain ke network ke tamam nodes mutafiqa (unanimous) faisle par pohanchein. Yeh durust nahi: Proof of Work mein computing taqat ki aksariyat (majority) aur Proof of Stake mein stake ki aksariyat ka faisla chalta hai. Kuch nodes band ya beimaan hon tab bhi naya block jur jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar Blockchain network: chhe Blockchain node daire jo aapas mein lakeeron se jure hain; teer neeche Blockchain database ki taraf jate hain, jahan Block 0, Block n-1 aur Block n mein Timestamp aur Transaction ke card hain, aur har block se teer pichhle block ki taraf ishara karta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.2: Blockchain ki misal (kitab ki Figure 6.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar ke nodes network ke computers hain; har node ke paas poore record ki copy hoti hai, is liye koi ek markaz nahi. Neeche database mein blocks ek zanjeer (chain) bante hain: har naya block pichhle block se jura hota hai, isi liye teer peeche ki taraf hain. Kisi purane block ko badla jaye to us ke baad ki saari zanjeer ka rishta toot jata hai, jis se tabdeeli pakri jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain mein immutability bataiye aur yeh kyun zaroori hai (short question 2). Immutability ki behtareen tashreeh kya hai (MCQ 13)?
blocks.explanation: (c) jorne ke baad data na badal sakna. Har block pichhle ka hash rakhta aur har node copy rakhta hai, to purana record badalne se rabte toot jayenge aur baqi copies se mel nahi khayega. Is se tareekh mustaqil aur qabil-e-aitbaar banti hai, jo paise, muahidon, certificates aur supply records ke liye zaroori hai.
